items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, I don't think so, no.

ctx.x: No, let's see, Tin Roof. Now that.
Brunis, uh, George Brunis and some of them, Leon Rapolo and Paul Merez first made a record of it up in Chicago. I wondered if you'd heard that before though?

No, no, I don't think so, no. I remember the old Tin Roof was, uh, was an old factory, way out on there, at the end of the Washington Blue Line. Back, way back in town. Now it's all built up. Yeah. And something went wrong.
